contract:
Desktop Orgs tab, student side. This merges invites spec B19-extended §5.3 with following spec F5c §5.3 into ONE edit of the same functions. Never run it in parallel with another campus-home batch. Anchors are at f23bc5d and will shift after B19 lands, so re-grep by function name.

1. Types
- DiscoverOrg (:8124-8140) gains join_state, join_reason, join_policy, audience, pending_invite, plus the org-follow field under whatever name F2 ships.
- Critic C8: it MUST NOT be named follow_state, which already means person-follow in this file (followOverrides :5863-5892, UserCardProps). Recommended: `viewer_follows: boolean`.

2. OrgsTabBody (:8143)
- The pending map (:8145, seeded :8189-8203) derives from join_state.
- Split handleJoin (:8211-8232) into:
  - handleFollow: POST/DELETE /api/orgs/[handle]/follow; a DELETE 409 member_follows is impossible from the UI because members see a disabled 'Following ✓';
  - handleJoin: POST /join.
  Both map error codes the way OrgJoinControl does:
  - invite_only → invite_only;
  - audience_mismatch → audience_blocked;
  - school_unverified → unverified;
  - not_found → "This org isn't available.";
  - 429 → 'Too many tries. Try again in a minute.'
- Wait for the server before flipping state (no optimistic flip).

3. SceneHeader subtitle (:8257)
- 'Follow any club to get its posts. Join to get its chats.' This replaces B19's interim sentence; the eyebrow keeps '· {campus}'.

4. Groups (:8360-8420, DiscoverGroup :8882)
- Prepend 'You're invited' (join_state==='invited', OrgInviteBanner-style row with Accept → POST /join and Decline → POST /api/me/org-invites/[id]).
- Then 'Yours' (members and followed clubs, each with its chip 'Joined' / 'Following').
- Then Verified, then the rest.
- Order inside groups follows the server's band order (orgs/route.ts:461).

5. DiscoverFilterChips (:9030-9048)
- Chips: All · Following · Open · By request · Invite only.
- The predicate at :8234-8240 filters on join_policy and the follow field.
- 'Following' means followed AND not a member (critic C16 second half), so it doesn't duplicate Joined.

6. DiscoverCard (:9087+) and OrgQuickViewModal (:8432+). Founder decision: on OPEN clubs, Follow and Join appear TOGETHER. There is no follow-before-join ladder, which overrides spec §5.0 rows 3-4.
- card/quick-view controls: primary = Follow ⇄ 'Following ✓' (disabled with sub 'Members follow automatically' for members; owners never get a toggle);
- secondary by join_state via joinCopy:
  - 'Join' (can_join);
  - 'Request to join' (can_request);
  - disabled 'Invite only' (invite_only);
  - 'Requested';
  - 'Accept invite' + 'Decline' (invited);
  - 'Joined ✓' (member);
  - disabled 'IU students only' / 'Purdue students only' (audience_blocked);
  - 'Verify your school email to join' → /auth/school-email (unverified);
  - 'Hidden' (hidden, admins only; critic C9).
- Under the Follow control on NON-open clubs, one line: 'Officers can see who follows this club.' (critic C14; M1d answer 3).
- Card meta (:9218-9234): '@handle · Invite only · IU only · 12 members'. NO follower count on any browse card (spec §5.3, No vanity metrics).
- member_count comes from the row; if null, omit it (critic C27). Do not render `?? 0` at :8446 / :9102.

7. Rail chip (:12105-12112)
- '{Invite only|By request|Open}' + (hidden ? ' · Hidden' : '') + ' · N channels'.
- The rail stays fed ONLY by ?filter=mine (:465).

8. Search dropdown (:3922-3936)
- The role line appends ' · Invite only' / ' · IU only' / ' · Purdue only' when present. The action stays 'View'.

9. Map org zone panel (ZonePanel :10887; empty copy :11103)
- For a viewer NOT in the loaded filter=mine set whose org join_policy !== 'open', add a footer line under the tabs, 'Members only. Follow to get their posts.' (the spec §5.6 line, relocated from the unreachable MapMobile:945).

Do not touch the settings/officer surfaces: B19-orgs-b.
